endorsements.name: Andrey Chasovskikh
endorsements.label: Inspection of Windows Phone applications
endorsements.description: The market share of Windows Phone devices continues to grow and so grows the number of WP applications: from simple games and social apps to complex business apps. WP security model is considered to be secure; nevertheless, the application themselves may have potential vulnerabilities.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Middle-East 2012
